id: \bNanu:... How did you even find me? First those three come here and now you. I need to find a new spot.
en: \bNanu:... How did you even find me? First those three come here and now you. I need to find a new spot.
it: \bNanu:... Come hai fatto a trovarmi? Prima quei tre e ora tu. Devo trovarmi un altro posto.

id: \bWell I guess it's too late to turn you away. Let's get this island trial going.
en: \bWell I guess it's too late to turn you away. Let's get this island trial going.
it: \bBeh, ormai è troppo tardi per mandarti via. Cominciamo con questa prova delle isole.

id: \bGood enough for a trial run but not enough for a real trial.
en: \bGood enough for a trial run but not enough for a real trial.
it: \bAbbastanza per una prova generale, ma non per una prova vera.

id: \bNanu: You again? I'm guessing a rematch... How about this? There were some people looking for you. I guess they can be a trial for you.
en: \bNanu: You again? I'm guessing a rematch... How about this? There were some people looking for you.  I guess they can be a trial for you.
it: \bNanu: Di nuovo tu? Immagino tu voglia la rivincita... Facciamo così: c'era della gente che ti cercava.  Possono essere loro la tua prova.

id: \bDon't come back until you beat them. They should be at the abandoned Thrifty Megamart by now.
en: \bDon't come back until you beat them. They should be at the abandoned Thrifty Megamart by now.
it: \bNon tornare finché non li avrai battuti. A quest'ora dovrebbero essere al Supermarket Affaroni abbandonato.

id: \bNanu:... So you finished it? I can't think of anything else to get you to leave me alone. The best way would probably be a battle, wouldn't it?
en: \bNanu:... So you finished it? I can't think of anything else to get you to leave me alone. The best way would probably be a battle, wouldn't it?
it: \bNanu:... Quindi l'hai finita? Non mi viene in mente nient'altro per farmi lasciare in pace. Il modo migliore sarebbe probabilmente una lotta, no?

id: \bBe warned, this is going to be a challenge. Beating a trial should be worth something, so you're only going to be allowed one Pokémon against my three.
en: \bBe warned, this is going to be a challenge. Beating a trial should be worth something, so you're only going to be allowed one Pokémon against my three.
it: \bTi avverto, sarà una bella sfida. Superare una prova deve pur valere qualcosa, quindi potrai usare un solo Pokémon contro i miei tre.

id: \bYou did good. Take this as a reward.
en: \bYou did good. Take this as a reward.
it: \bTe la sei cavata bene. Prendi questo come ricompensa.

id: \bA Lycanium Z. With that you can power up your Stone Edge if Lycanroc knows it.
en: \bA Lycanium Z. With that you can power up your Stone Edge if Lycanroc knows it.
it: \bUn Lycanrochium Z. Con quello puoi potenziare Pietrataglio, se il tuo Lycanroc la conosce.

id: \bI was thinking of giving you a Darkinium Z, but that doesn't seem to fit your personality.
en: \bI was thinking of giving you a Darkinium Z, but that doesn't seem to fit your personality.
it: \bPensavo di darti un Obscurium Z, ma non sembra adatto al tuo carattere.

id: Rotom Dex: Let's go back and inform the professor of your win.
en: Rotom Dex: Let's go back and inform the professor of your win.
it: Rotom Dex: Torniamo a informare il professore della tua vittoria.

id: \bNanu: You've won. Leave me in peace now.
en: \bNanu: You've won. Leave me in peace now.
it: \bNanu: Hai vinto. Ora lasciami in pace.
